configurations.name: Android: Run App
configurations.command: bash -lc 'cd "${workspaceFolder}" && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug && ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && export ANDROID_HOME ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME" PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:$PATH" && adb install -r -t -g "${workspaceFolder}/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk" && adb shell monkey -p com.usharik.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1'
